name: Mixed-owner transwarp toll settlement, refusal destruction and recovery

tests.name: Register first toll owner
Register second toll owner
Register ordinary toll payer
Register ordinary toll refuser
Create isolated transwarp routes and deterministic player balances [1/5]

data.sql: INSERT INTO sector_warps(from_sector,to_sector) VALUES (1,20),(20,21) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

tests.name: Create isolated transwarp routes and deterministic player balances [2/5]

data.sql: UPDATE players SET credits=1000000000 WHERE name IN ('mixed_toll_owner_a','mixed_toll_owner_b')

tests.name: Create isolated transwarp routes and deterministic player balances [3/5]

data.sql: UPDATE players SET credits=1000,sector_id=1 WHERE name='mixed_toll_payer'

tests.name: Create isolated transwarp routes and deterministic player balances [4/5]

data.sql: UPDATE players SET credits=1000,sector_id=20 WHERE name='mixed_toll_refuser'

tests.name: Create isolated transwarp routes and deterministic player balances [5/5]

data.sql: UPDATE turns SET turns_remaining=500 WHERE player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name IN ('mixed_toll_payer','mixed_toll_refuser'))

tests.name: Clear isolated toll destination assets

data.sql: DELETE FROM sector_assets WHERE sector_id IN (20,21);

tests.name: Equip payer transwarp, fuel, shields and deterministic active ship [1/2]

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=1,has_transwarp=TRUE,holds=200,ore=100,shields=100,installed_shields=100,hull=100,fighters=0,destroyed=FALSE,onplanet=FALSE,ported=0 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='mixed_toll_payer')

tests.name: Equip payer transwarp, fuel, shields and deterministic active ship [2/2]

data.sql: INSERT INTO ship_cargo(ship_id,commodity_code,quantity) SELECT ship_id,'ORE',100 FROM players WHERE name='mixed_toll_payer' ON CONFLICT(ship_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=100

tests.name: Deploy two toll fighters for each independent owner

data.sql: INSERT INTO sector_assets(sector_id,owner_id,corporation_id,asset_type,quantity,offensive_setting,ttl) SELECT 20,player_id,0,2,2,3,0 FROM players WHERE name IN ('mixed_toll_owner_a','mixed_toll_owner_b');

tests.name: Deploy payer's destination homing fighter

data.sql: INSERT INTO sector_assets(sector_id,owner_id,corporation_id,asset_type,quantity,offensive_setting,ttl) SELECT 20,player_id,0,2,1,2,0 FROM players WHERE name='mixed_toll_payer';

tests.name: Mixed-owner offer totals all toll fighters
Accept mixed-owner toll and pass
Verify split payment, fuel, turn and offer commit atomically

data.sql: SELECT p.credits,p.sector_id,t.turns_remaining,c.quantity,o.state,o.amount,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM toll_passage_payees py WHERE py.offer_id='@{mixed_offer}'),(SELECT SUM(py.amount) FROM toll_passage_payees py WHERE py.offer_id='@{mixed_offer}'),(SELECT credits FROM players WHERE name='mixed_toll_owner_a'),(SELECT credits FROM players WHERE name='mixed_toll_owner_b') FROM players p JOIN turns t ON t.player_id=p.player_id JOIN ship_cargo c ON c.ship_id=p.ship_id AND c.commodity_code='ORE' JOIN toll_passage_offers o ON o.offer_id='@{mixed_offer}' WHERE p.name='mixed_toll_payer';

tests.name: Retry accepted mixed-owner offer
Verify retry did not duplicate either owner's credits or payer resources

data.sql: SELECT p.credits,t.turns_remaining,c.quantity,(SELECT credits FROM players WHERE name='mixed_toll_owner_a'),(SELECT credits FROM players WHERE name='mixed_toll_owner_b') FROM players p JOIN turns t ON t.player_id=p.player_id JOIN ship_cargo c ON c.ship_id=p.ship_id AND c.commodity_code='ORE' WHERE p.name='mixed_toll_payer';

tests.name: Prepare lethal refusal at a second destination [1/4]

data.sql: INSERT INTO sector_assets(sector_id,owner_id,corporation_id,asset_type,quantity,offensive_setting,ttl) SELECT 21,player_id,0,2,1,3,0 FROM players WHERE name='mixed_toll_owner_a'

tests.name: Prepare lethal refusal at a second destination [2/4]

data.sql: INSERT INTO sector_assets(sector_id,owner_id,corporation_id,asset_type,quantity,offensive_setting,ttl) SELECT 21,player_id,0,2,1,2,0 FROM players WHERE name='mixed_toll_refuser'

tests.name: Prepare lethal refusal at a second destination [3/4]

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=20,has_transwarp=TRUE,holds=200,ore=50,shields=0,installed_shields=0,hull=1,fighters=0,destroyed=FALSE,onplanet=FALSE,ported=0 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='mixed_toll_refuser')

tests.name: Prepare lethal refusal at a second destination [4/4]

data.sql: INSERT INTO ship_cargo(ship_id,commodity_code,quantity) SELECT ship_id,'ORE',50 FROM players WHERE name='mixed_toll_refuser' ON CONFLICT(ship_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=50

tests.name: Capture refuser's destroyed hull identity

data.sql: SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='mixed_toll_refuser';

tests.name: Refresh refuser's authenticated sector after deterministic setup
Refuser receives single-fighter offer
Refusal triggers lethal hostile toll encounter
Verify no refusal payment and one durable escape-pod recovery

data.sql: SELECT p.credits,p.sector_id,t.turns_remaining,CASE WHEN old.destroyed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,old.hull,CASE WHEN pod.destroyed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,st.name,ps.status,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ship_ownership so WHERE so.player_id=p.player_id AND so.ship_id=pod.ship_id AND so.is_primary=TRUE),o.state,o.amount,(SELECT credits FROM players WHERE name='mixed_toll_owner_a') FROM players p JOIN turns t ON t.player_id=p.player_id JOIN ships old ON old.ship_id=@{refuser_ship} JOIN ships pod ON pod.ship_id=p.ship_id JOIN shiptypes st ON st.shiptypes_id=pod.type_id JOIN podded_status ps ON ps.player_id=p.player_id JOIN toll_passage_offers o ON o.offer_id='@{refusal_offer}' WHERE p.name='mixed_toll_refuser';

tests.name: Reconnect ordinary refuser after destruction
Verify recovery remains after reauthentication

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.sector_id=1 AND old.destroyed=TRUE AND pod.destroyed=FALSE AND st.name='Escape Pod' AND ps.status='podded' AND o.state='refused' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM players p JOIN ships old ON old.ship_id=@{refuser_ship} JOIN ships pod ON pod.ship_id=p.ship_id JOIN shiptypes st ON st.shiptypes_id=pod.type_id JOIN podded_status ps ON ps.player_id=p.player_id JOIN toll_passage_offers o ON o.player_id=p.player_id AND o.offer_id='@{refusal_offer}' WHERE p.name='mixed_toll_refuser';
